operator: index.html: a stylesheet rule *:focus,*:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0)} replaces the focus ring with a fully transparent shadow: the computed style changes, no pixel does. The must-fail twin's detector class is a transparent outline too. The must-pass twin draws its ring through a keyboard-mode detector: a class added on focusin only when a keydown happened within 100 ms, as focus-visible polyfills do, so focus that does not arrive by a key press shows nothing. Both twins carry an autofocus input with a 300 ms box-shadow transition, an infinitely pulsing status dot, a button inside a zero-height overflow:hidden container and a link inside an opacity:0 paragraph (in the tab order, never painted: reported as a finding, not measured), and an ins.adsbygoogle block with a focus-less link, a zero letter-spacing lock and low-contrast text: the third-party exclusion must keep all three probes silent on it.
